content.comment_body: Hello, I received a message after downloading my program, which seems to indicate that I've exceeded the memory limit.

Hi, this isn't a major issue. There is some memory reserved for saving block positions on the page. If you upload the program, the blocks will appear as you arranged them, unless the memory limit is exceeded—then their positions may change. This typically isn't a problem for those who keep offline copies of their programs and don't depend on the uploaded version.
Thanks, that's a relief. I was still organizing everything, so I'll make sure to tidy it up. Appreciate the quick response.

analysis.insight_summary: A user received a warning message after downloading their program, suggesting a memory limit was reached concerning block arrangement. Their concern was about whether this affected program operation. Another user clarified that the warning only impacts how blocks are visually arranged upon upload and does not affect overall functionality. For users maintaining offline copies, the issue is minor.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants clear notifications about memory usage and reassurance that such warnings do not compromise program function.
